findings.finding: The testing plan pins marker extraction for well-formed payloads (one block, last-wins, fenced-object-inside, ordering) but never pins the failure path where a marker block is present yet its enclosed content is invalid/malformed against the schema. findings.suggested_fix: State the contract for validation-failing marker blocks (e.g. 'a marker block failing validate_to is skipped and extraction continues to earlier marker blocks, then falls back to the selection pipeline') and add a parameterized test pinning it.

findings.finding: The plan specifies a fallback only for 'markerless' replies; it never states what extraction does when the markers ARE present but the delimited block fails to parse or validate (a present-but-malformed marker block).
findings.location: Approach; Scope (structured.py extraction bullet); Testing / Acceptance Criteria
scenarios: A model emits <<<REBAR_OUTPUT>>> ... <<<END>>> but the enclosed text has a trailing comma / is truncated / fails validation. It is unspecified whether extraction raises (surfacing a bounded retry) or silently falls through to the schema-filtered selection pipeline — which could then select an unrelated schema-valid decoy elsewhere in the reply, the exact failure mode the markers were introduced to prevent.
